content: {"episode_id":"ep-05249","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229), for which authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents intermittent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat that persisted despite initial evaluation. Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered for extended ambulatory assessment to further characterize the underlying rhythm disturbance and correlate symptoms with cardiac activity."}
